{{Quote|Kessel is ''so beautiful&mdash;!''<nowiki></nowiki>|[[Mira Volz]], to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="Second Kessel Run" />}}
'''Little Kessel''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Kessel sector/Legends|Kessel sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Wow! Are these towers ''trees,'' Mira&mdash;?''"<br />"''No, Luke&hellip; ''gigantic fungus!'' The thickest, wildest forest on Kessel&mdash;!|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Mira Volz]]|<ref name="Second Kessel Run" />}}
Little Kessel was the lush, verdant [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the peaceful [[Kesselian]]s. It housed a titanic mushroom patch called the [[Giant Fungi Forest]].<ref name="The Unseen Planets of Star Wars" /> Contrarily to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], Little Kessel was considered to be a beautiful [[Planet/Legends|planet]] by its inhabitants.<ref name="Second Kessel Run" />

By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Little Kessel was geologically stable and had not experienced a [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquake]] in so many eons that its inhabitants did not even know what one was. When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Devastation of Little Kessel|attacked]] the planet with the [[Ionic Ring Ship|''Ionic Ring'']], the [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] created groundquakes that caused the formation of [[Volcano/Legends|volcanoes]].<ref name="Second Kessel Run" />

==History==
===Cold War===
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Little Kessel was ruled by [[Xim'tahal]] the Defaced, a fierce [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]].<ref name="TORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

===Galactic Civil War===
{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Planet of Kessel&mdash;!'' You ''will cooperate!'' You ''will'' surrender ''all'' the Rebels on your world&hellip; or suffer the consequences!|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Bzorn]]|<ref name="Second Kessel Run" />}}
[[File:Devastation_of_Little_Kessel.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The [[Ionic Ring Ship|''Ionic Ring'']] [[Devastation of Little Kessel|devastates]] Little Kessel]]
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Little Kessel was home to hundreds of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]]. In 0 ABY, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Bzorn]] traveled to Little Kessel aboard the ''Ionic Ring'' and demanded that all Rebels on the planet be surrendered. When the government of Little Kessel refused, the Galactic Empire tormented the planet with groundquakes and cyclones.<ref name="Second Kessel Run" />

[[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Renn Volz]], the creator of the [[Starship/Legends|ship]], eventually refused to help Bzorn continue the devastation of the planet, despite the fact that his daughter, [[Mira Volz]], was supposedly being held hostage. In reality, Mira had escaped from the Empire and recruited the help of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. The three Rebels infiltrated the ''Ionic Ring'' and rescued the professor, who reversed the flow of the ship's [[ion unit]]s, causing a meltdown that destroyed the superweapon.<ref name="Second Kessel Run" />

==Behind the scenes==
Little Kessel first appeared in the newstrip [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] ''[[The Second Kessel Run]]'' by [[Russ Manning]], later reprinted in [[Classic Star Wars: The Early Adventures 6|''Classic Star Wars: The Early Adventures'' 6]]. It was identified at the time as [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]. This interpretation of Kessel was ignored by later authors, who identified Kessel as a barren, rocky world resembling an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]]. This discrepancy remained unaddressed until ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', where a second planet, Little Kessel, was identified in close proximity to Kessel. [[Jason Fry]] later confirmed in the [[Jedi Council Forums]] that Little Kessel was created to retcon the two different interpretations of Kessel, and that Little Kessel was the lush version found in ''The Second Kessel Run''.<ref name="Jason Fry Little Kessel">{{JCFCite|url=posts/30364686|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2009-08-20|time=5:45 AM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20171212045150/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-90|quote=Yes. A bit of a "Hoth Stuff" style retcon, perhaps, but I thought it worked OK.}}</ref>
